page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.large is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using a KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile is driven by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor operating at 2.7 GHz, delivering 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with 2 threads. Cache specifications include 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates advanced CPU hardware features, including AVX-512 extensions (AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. System memory totals 4.0 GB, yielding 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include local disk storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-core execution performance, placing in the top 25% for both stress-ng single-core (3059.78) and Geekbench single-core (1939.0) tests. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks show weak relative performance—ranking in the bottom 25% for stress-ng multi-core (3062.79) and Geekbench multi-core (2433.0)—reflecting physical core constraints. Memory access tests indicate lower throughput, with small cached read bandwidth measured at 150.55 GB/sec (bottom 10%) and uncached large block reads at 37.76 GB/sec (bottom 25%). High-concurrency operations also fall in lower percentiles, as PassMark database operations and static web serving throughput sit in the bottom 10%.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and strong per-thread benchmark profile, the instance provides qualitative resource efficiency for light single-threaded compute workloads. It is best suited for entry-level tasks, light background script execution, and modest single-threaded microservices. It is less effective for multi-threaded applications, high-concurrency database platforms, or memory-intensive analytical processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.large is a compute-optimized instance powered by a 2.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9T24 processor with 2 vCPUs on 1 physical core, 4.0 GB of system memory, and no local disk storage. Running on a KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture, it features 32 MB of L3 cache, advanced execution extensions like AVX-512, and a 2 Gbps baseline network throughput. Benchmark performance indicates strong single-core compute capabilities, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench single-thread tests. Multi-core execution, memory bandwidth, and database operations remain limited by the single-core hardware profile. With dedicated CPU allocation and a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance provides efficient resource allocation for entry-level single-threaded processing, small microservices, and light background tasks.
